transcript: Speaker A: तेरा नाम क्या है? [What is your name?] Speaker B: सुरेश शर्मा सर। [Suresh Sharma, sir.] Speaker A: शर्मा? अरे वाह! तुम्हारे बाप-दादा ने हमपे राज किया, अब हमारी बारी है। फाइल रख यहाँ, जब मन करेगा देखेंगे। जा बाहर बैठ। [Sharma? Oh wow! Your ancestors ruled over us, now it's our turn. Keep the file here, I'll look at it when I feel like it. Go sit outside.] Speaker B: Sir, may I say something? Speaker A: इंग्लिश? तू इंग्लिश बोल रहा है? [English? You are speaking English?] Speaker B: Yes, sir. Because I want you to listen. Not as a Sharma, not as an upper caste, as a citizen standing at your counter for three days. Speaker A: अरे देखो, इंग्लिश भी आती है शर्मा को। [Oh look, the Sharma also knows English.] Speaker B: Sir, you are in power today, that is a good thing. You earned it, your community fought for it, I respect that. But what you are doing right now, delaying my file because of my surname, this is the same thing that was done to your people. You hated it then, why are you doing it now? Speaker A: तू मुझे सिखाएगा? [Will you teach me?] Speaker B: I'm not teaching you, sir. I'm requesting you. Discrimination does not become right when the direction changes. Wrong is wrong, no matter who does it. आपके पास पावर है, यूज़ इट टू बी फेयर। नॉट टू टेक रिवेंज ऑन समवन हु नेवर डिड एनीथिंग टू यू। [You have power, use it to be fair. Not to take revenge on someone who never did anything to you.] Speaker B: Sir, I come from a family that had nothing. My father drove an auto. शर्मा सरनेम से कुछ नहीं मिला हमें। [We got nothing from the Sharma surname.] I learned English on my own. इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप से, जनरल इंग्लिश शो से, एआई कोच से। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। [From the English Seekho app, General English Show, AI Coach. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected it 500 times.] मैंने इंग्लिश इसलिए सीखी क्योंकि मुझे पता था, एक दिन मुझे अपनी बात रखनी पड़ेगी। और आज वो दिन है। प्लीज स्टैम्प माय फाइल सर, आई हैव बीन वेटिंग। [I learned English because I knew one day I would have to present my case. And today is that day. Please stamp my file sir, I have been waiting.] Speaker A: फाइल दे यहाँ। [Give me the file.] Speaker B: थैंक यू सर। और सर, आपके बेटे को भी इंग्लिश सिखाओ। पावर हमेशा नहीं रहती, स्किल रहती है। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करवा दो उन्हें, जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोल दो, एक महीने में फर्क दिखेगा। पावर से इज्जत नहीं मिलती सर, बोलने से मिलती है। [Thank you, sir. And sir, teach your son English too. Power doesn't last forever, skill does. Get them to download the English Seekho app, open the General English Show, you'll see a difference in a month. Respect is not gained through power, sir, it is gained through speaking.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
